$description: Dispatch design tokens — machine-readable mirror of frontend/src/styles/tokens.css (which stays authoritative for the running UI). tests/unit/design-tokens.test.ts asserts the two never drift. Meanings and usage rules: DESIGN.md.
$schema_note: Shape follows the W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft loosely: {$type, $value} leaves grouped by theme.
$theme_note: light is the DEFAULT theme (Calm direction, operator directive 2026-08-21); dark is applied by OS preference or the explicit toggle.
$type_note: Three self-hosted variable faces (CLAUDE.md Frontend aesthetics, 2026-09-11): Bricolage Grotesque for the UI, Fraunces for display, JetBrains Mono for anything copyable. Weight is used at its extremes — light 200 / heavy 800 — with regular 400 for running text.

mono.$value: "JetBrains Mono Variable", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: Anything the operator might copy, grep, or compare: ids, hashes, states, evidence, log lines, the wordmark. Self-hosted via @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono.

ui.$description: Prose, labels, buttons. Self-hosted via @fontsource-variable/bricolage-grotesque — no CDN, so the console still renders correctly with no network.

display.$description: Hero and section display only — the public app's landing and the marketing site. Never for body copy or controls. Self-hosted via @fontsource-variable/fraunces (opsz + wght axes).

weight.$description: The only weights in the system. Hierarchy is the contrast between light and heavy; 500–700 do not exist here.

heavy.$description: the one emphasized word, labels, buttons

type.$description: The only sizes permitted in components. base/sm/xs/lg are DESIGN.md's original documented scale; 2xs, md and xl extend it at the ends; 2xl–5xl are display rungs.

3xl.$description: display step — marketing prices and numbers

4xl.$description: display step — section display, phone-width hero

5xl.$description: display step — the hero; ~4.7× body, a jump not a nudge

space.$description: All component padding/margin rides this scale, varied by hierarchy. Identical spacing everywhere is a templated look, not a designed one.

7.$description: between major page sections — the deliberate breathing room

motion.$description: Motion is only ever a state change or an arrival, never decoration. Every use is wrapped by the prefers-reduced-motion guard in base.css. slow + stagger are for ONE orchestrated page-load reveal, not for hover states.

stagger.$description: delay between siblings in the reveal

color.$description: One warm bone/ink neutral ramp and ONE brand accent (ultramarine). Every text and signal color clears WCAG AA 4.5:1 on bg and bg-raised in both themes — computed by the token test.

accent.$description: navigation, links, in-progress; the brand color

shadow.$description: Depth, not palette. Two steps only: sm for resting elevation, default for the one modal.

lg.$description: hero and other large surfaces — radius varies with surface size

layer.$description: The only z-index values in the system.

breakpoint-compact.$description: below this the sidebar becomes a top bar

breakpoint-phone.$description: below this the public surface is one-handed: 16px inputs, 44px tap targets, one column
